accepted.title: A Pin(2)-equivariant sutured monopole Floer theory
accepted.text: A balanced sutured manifold (M,γ) consists of a compact oriented3-manifold with no closed components and oriented sutures γ⊂∂M whose annular neighbourhood separates ∂M into R₊ and R₋, with no closed components of R₊∪R₋ and χ(R₊)=χ(R₋). Can one construct a Pin(2)-equivariant version of sutured monopole Floer homology, with isomorphism type independent of the auxiliary closure data, in the sense of a sutured analogue of Lin’s Pin(2)-monopole Floer theory?
accepted.subject: Geometric Topology & Floer Homology

accepted.title: Remove the unit ambiguity in sutured monopole and instanton naturality
accepted.text: A balanced sutured manifold (M,γ) consists of a compact oriented3-manifold with no closed components and oriented sutures γ⊂∂M whose annular neighbourhood separates ∂M into R₊ and R₋, with no closed components of R₊∪R₋ and χ(R₊)=χ(R₋). Can the naturality identifications for sutured monopole and sutured instanton Floer homology be defined canonically as actual linear maps, rather than only up to multiplication by a unit of the coefficient ring, compatibly with identity maps and composition? In the monopole theory use the Novikov coefficients of the closure construction; in the instanton theory useℂ. The question concerns the closure-independent theory, not an arbitrary basis chosen in each closure.

accepted.title: Sutured Floer rank-depth bounds without vanishing second homology
accepted.text: A balanced sutured manifold (M,γ) consists of a compact oriented3-manifold with no closed components and oriented sutures γ⊂∂M whose annular neighbourhood separates ∂M into R₊ and R₋, with no closed components of R₊∪R₋ and χ(R₊)=χ(R₋). Suppose (M,γ) is taut: M is irreducible and R₊,R₋ are incompressible and Thurston-norm minimizing. For G=M (sutured monopole Floer homology with Novikov-field coefficients) or G=I (sutured instanton homology overℂ), and every integer k≥0, does rank SHG(M,γ)<2^{k+1} imply d(M,γ)≤2k without assuming H₂(M;ℤ)=0? Here d is the sutured-hierarchy depth in Definition 2.1.19: the minimum n admitting a taut hierarchy (M₀,γ₀)→⋯→(M_{n+1},γ_{n+1}) from (M,γ) to a product sutured manifold, using the source's indexing convention.
accepted.subject: Geometric Topology & Floer Homology

accepted.title: An analytic construction of the sutured instanton contact element
accepted.text: A balanced sutured manifold (M,γ) consists of a compact oriented3-manifold with no closed components and oriented sutures γ⊂∂M whose annular neighbourhood separates ∂M into R₊ and R₋, with no closed components of R₊∪R₋ and χ(R₊)=χ(R₋). Let ξ be a positive contact structure on M with convex boundary and dividing setγ. Is there a direct analytic gauge-theoretic construction of the contact class in SHI(−M,−γ) that agrees, up to its natural nonzero complex scalar ambiguity, with the Baldwin–Sivek class obtained by composing contact-handle maps from the standard contact3-ball?

accepted.title: The sutured trace cobordism induces the evaluation pairing
accepted.text: A balanced sutured manifold (M,γ) consists of a compact oriented3-manifold with no closed components and oriented sutures γ⊂∂M whose annular neighbourhood separates ∂M into R₊ and R₋, with no closed components of R₊∪R₋ and χ(R₊)=χ(R₋). Let 𝒲=(M×[0,1],∂M×[0,1],[ξ₀]) be the sutured trace cobordism from (M,γ)⊔(−M,−γ) to the empty sutured manifold, where ξ₀ is the invariant product contact structure having dividing setγ. For sutured monopole or instanton homology, is SHG(𝒲) equal, up to the natural unit ambiguity, to tr∘i? Here i is the Künneth map to SHG(M,γ)⊗SHG(−M,−γ), and tr(a⊗b)=b(a) uses the canonical duality pairing.
accepted.subject: Geometric Topology & Floer Homology
